8.text:
<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Pullurp<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Pullurp was the most celebrated of all athletes
who participated in the Ultrapump Games.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>He lifted his body up with such force that
onlookers feared it would crack the firmament.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>He thrust it downwards with such enthusiasm
that he threatened to breach the earth's mantle.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>And yet, his lone failure came on the parallel bars,
where the Double Glute Spin eluded him all his life.<C:0003,0001,>
